title: Why would women pick the bear?
summary: Long commentary on the viral 'man or bear' question, asking men to step out of their perspective. Using homicide statistics, a third-sex thought experiment, personal anecdotes and passages from Gavin de Becker's The Gift of Fear, he argues women's fear of men is a rational survival mechanism and that angry male reactions only confirm it.
claims: The idea that men are the number one cause of death for women is a myth; the top killers are health-related (heart disease, cancer, Alzheimer's, diabetes) and accidents
In 2020 about 300,000 US women died of heart disease (1 in 5 deaths), 10,000 in car accidents and about 3,000 by murder (roughly 1 in 500 deaths)
Men commit about 80 percent of homicides; in about 9 of 10 femicides the killer is a man the woman knows, and around 60 percent of those are partners
Men are murdered at far higher rates (about 80 percent of victims), mostly by strangers; only about 5 percent are killed by partners
Bears kill only about 1-6 people a year in North America, but only because humans rarely live near them
Women pick the bear because they live with men, not bears; the question is really a way to express how they feel about men
Men have a far higher propensity for violence than women and are more efficient at it because they are stronger; denying this is false both statistically and biologically
A bear attacks out of hunger or territory and can be avoided; male aggression toward women is driven by sexual desire, which a woman cannot avoid simply by existing
Unlike a bear, a rejected man may retaliate, follow or attack, which is why many women adopt a cold demeanor in public
Men do not wear their intentions on their face, so women must treat every man as a potential predator
A college date insisted on talking in public before inviting him over, so she would be safe if he reacted badly to her not wanting anything serious

Thought experiment: imagine a third sex as much stronger than men as men are than women (about 6'7 and 250-280 lb of muscle for a 6' man) that is sexually attracted to you; you would not feel safe in an elevator with one
At 3 am in college his neighbor was terrified when he entered the building behind her; he waited and let her take the elevator alone
Women are socially conditioned to be kind to men, which strips them of their instinct for self-protection; he recommends women read The Gift of Fear
Being oblivious to these survival mechanisms is a male privilege, while being shielded from social loneliness is a female one
Men who angrily reject women's criticism display exactly the traits that make men dangerous and then blame women for a dead dating scene
Men who write off women also picked the bear, but out of resentment where women chose out of fear
